supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:31 UTC, WS-ZADAMS-01 requested `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunridge-it/tools/main/u.ps1` through the proxy; the request had user-agent `-` and returned status 200.
The script request occurred close in time to the reported brief PowerShell window, so it could be related; the available records do not establish that the script was opened or executed.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records include proxy and network activity but no process-creation or command-line record showing PowerShell launching or executing the downloaded script.
The records do not provide the downloaded script's contents, file path, hash, or endpoint file-write evidence.
A proxy status 200 and connection byte counts establish a request and response, not what the returned content contained or whether it ran.
claims_not_established: Whether the downloaded `u.ps1` was saved, opened, or executed.
Whether the PowerShell window Zoe reported was caused by this request or by another activity.
Whether the repository and script were authorized for Zoe's workstation or benign in content.
additional_evidence_needed: Collect endpoint process telemetry and PowerShell operational/script-block logs for WS-ZADAMS-01 around 13:40 UTC, including command lines, parent process, and user context.
Recover the downloaded file or proxy-cached response, then inspect its contents and compute a hash.
Check endpoint file and browser-download history around 13:40 UTC and confirm with Zoe whether she initiated the download.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: a network logon for ian.doyle to WS-IDOYLE-01 originated from WS-ZADAMS-01 at 13:33 UTC; the records do not show what activity, if any, followed that logon. This is not evidence that the alerted script executed. (T233-00091, T233-00092, T233-00094)

Separate review: WS-ZADAMS-01 accessed Google Docs during the interval, which is an unapproved cloud-storage service in the supplied inventory. This does not establish a connection to the alerted PowerShell activity. (T233-00051, T233-00052, T233-00072)

Separate review: WS-ZADAMS-01 accessed Slack and `downloads.cloud.com`, and made a proxy request with a GlobalProtect user agent, despite the supplied inventory stating that no VPN or other remote-access service is approved. These observations do not establish a connection to the alert. (T233-00335, T233-00336, T233-00226, T233-00234)
